title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing CS/CE degree, proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python.
description: Gain hands-on software development experience working on core Microsoft technologies alongside industry experts.

title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students from Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience.
qualification: Undergraduate degree equivalent to UK upper second-class 2:1 honours degree.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees in the UK.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early career professionals with 0-2 years of product management experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Work across cross-functional teams to build and launch product features for millions of global users.

title: Junior Front-End Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with strong JavaScript/Vue.js skills.
qualification: 1+ years experience in web development, strong knowledge of modern JS frameworks and Git.
description: Join GitLab's fully remote engineering team to help build and optimize user-facing features on the GitLab platform.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 18+ actively enrolled in a high school, college, or university.
qualification: Team of up to 4 students, must utilize Microsoft Cloud and AI technologies.
description: Global student technology competition providing participants the opportunity to bring their tech ideas to life.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, and JS.
